# ADR-004: Notes are plain text

**Status:** Accepted
**Date:** 2026-06-02
**Owner:** notes team

## Context

The first version of notes needed a body format.

## Existing Primitives Audit

None.

## Decision

A note's body is plain text.

## Alternatives Considered

- Markdown — deferred.

## Consequences

No renderer.

## Wiring & Contract Changes

None.

## Out of Scope

- Rich text.
